fix: but also within Greece itself [...] and you make yourself answerable
reason: Real lacuna (*) after ἐν τοῖς Ἑλληνικοῖς; mark it, keep existing wording; καὶ διδοῖς = 'and you make yourself answerable'.

fix: because he foretold the times for sailing out in the regions of the strait
reason: προσημαίνοντα τοὺς ἔκπλους: signaled in advance the sailings (weather/timing), not 'routes'. Causal reading of participle is acceptable.

fix: from hunting them the galeotes grow fat—fish which, he says, are also called swordfish and sea-dogs
reason: ἐκ τῆς θήρας αὐτῶν: from hunting them (likely the tuna), not feeding on dolphins; 'them' keeps Greek ambiguity. καὶ…καὶ = 'and'.

fix: [...] the very matters in which he refutes those men is he free of them.
reason: Continues ch.5 'not even in [...]' (ἀλλ᾽ οὐδ᾽ ἐν αὐτοῖς): he is not free of popular pronouncements; English inverted the sense.

fix: more than eleven thousand two hundred stades
reason: μυρίων καὶ πλειόνων ἢ διακοσίων ἐπὶ τοῖς χιλίοις = 10,000 plus more than 1,200.

fix: across the Sardinian Sea the distance is reduced
reason: λαμβάνειν συναγωγήν: the distance contracts across the Sardinian Sea; hence the concession 'let that too be three thousand'.

fix: but by sea voyage it is five hundred stades less.
reason: πεντακοσίων δέουσαν: falling short of the 3,000 by 500, not under 500 in total. Candidate's added '2,500' is interpolation.

fix: Polybius in the thirty-fourth book says that Lemnos is called Aethaleia.
reason: Articular τὴν Λῆμνον is the subject; Αἰθάλειαν is the predicate name.

fix: that the seas are connected by channels [...] from the fact that Chian and Thasian pottery is found in the Naro
reason: Real lacuna (***) after τὰ πελάγη; mark with [...] per convention, keep ἀπὸ τοῦ εὑρίσκεσθαι as inference.
The '...' is Strabo's excerpt omission, not a lacuna mark; elsewhere unmarked in this edition. κατ᾽ ἐκεῖνον = 'according to him' already.
λοιπὸν ἦν τῷ ὄντι: the verse really applied; 'the poet’s words were literally true' conveys the sense acceptably. No sense error.
